description.value:
Trigger You Raise a Shield.

You did not raise the shield because you saw something. You raised it because you always do.

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1), which last until the start of your next turn. If you have not moved since the start of your last turn, you gain twice that number instead. These temporary Hit Points do not stack with themselves.

cinderfall.incomplete: Self temp HP = Con mod (min 1), doubled if the caster hasn't moved, on Raising a Shield as a reaction. Matches pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/barbarian/level-8/renewed-vigor.json (rules: []) + pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feat-effects/effect-renewed-vigor.json -- a triggered, resolved-once TempHP grant lives on a separate companion effect item applied when the ability resolves, never as a bare rule element on the triggering card itself. No deadhand.braced-for-worse-effect.json exists in this corpus.
